items.title: ESMO26: SANOVO data backs 1L Orpathys use in NSCLC subgroup, but AEs temper reaction
items.summary: Positive Phase III results from the SANOVO and SAFFRON studies with Orpathys raise several sequencing and usage considerations.

items.title: Transitioning from lab bench to GMP: What research scientists should know about manual aseptic filling
items.summary: When it’s time to look for a fill-finish CDMO, the transition to GMP filling is not just a scale issue — it’s a regulatory, technical, and operational shift.

items.title: Lunit and Summit to evaluate pathology platform for tumour analysis
items.summary: Lunit and Summit Therapeutics have entered a research agreement to assess the Lunit SCOPE IO AI pathology platform for analysing the tumour microenvironment across immuno-oncology programmes evaluating ivonescimab.

items.title: Pathos AI completes $237m Series E round to expand oncology pipeline
items.summary: Pathos AI has secured $237m in a Series E round to expand its clinical oncology pipeline and scale its AI drug development platform.

items.title: UK biotech poised for record VC year after maintaining recovery momentum
items.summary: British biotech generally raised more across public and private markets in Q3 2026, despite an overall downturn in the flow of VC more generally into the UK.
